title: CombatStreaks
description: Clean PvP killstreaks with milestones, shutdowns, rewards, and leaderboards.
body:
# CombatStreaks

CombatStreaks adds a clean PvP killstreak loop to Paper servers with streak tracking, milestones, shutdowns, rewards, and built-in menus.

## Features

- Polished `/streaks` GUI for PvP progress
- Top streak leaderboard
- Player stats view
- Configurable milestones
- Command rewards
- Shutdown rewards for killing high-streak players
- Same-victim anti-farm protection
- Editable config
- No dependencies

## Commands

- `/streaks` opens the main GUI
- `/streaks top` opens the leaderboard
- `/streaks milestones` opens milestones
- `/streaks rewards` opens rewards
- `/streaks stats [player]` views stats
- `/streaks reload` reloads config
- `/streaks reset <player>` resets a streak
- `/streaks set <player> <amount>` sets a streak
- `/streaks setbest <player> <amount>` sets best streak

## Permissions

- `combatstreaks.use` lets players use CombatStreaks menus and commands
- `combatstreaks.top` lets players view the leaderboard
- `combatstreaks.stats` lets players view stats
- `combatstreaks.admin` lets admins reload config and manage streak values
